name: NinjaDraw – Create Diagrams, Sketches & Visual Workflows
author: Yalogica

sections.description:
🏆 The Best Flowcharts and Diagrams Builder for WordPress

Create flowcharts, diagrams, and sketches with NinjaDraw, a hand-drawn style editor based on Excalidraw. Designed for bloggers and marketers, this tool allows for easy visual content creation. Perfect for educational blogs, business dashboards, project planning, and creative storytelling. Whether you’re a blogger, educator, marketer, or developer, NinjaDraw empowers you to design diagrams directly in WordPress – no coding or design skills needed! Seamlessly integrate flowcharts, brainstorming boards, and custom illustrations into your posts, pages, or sidebars.

📗 DOCUMENTATION
🔥 NINJADRAW PRO

🚀 Optimized Performance

Note: NinjaDraw is built with website speed in mind. In the WordPress admin, the heavy editor engine loads only when needed using smart lazy loading. On the frontend, your site remains lightning-fast because it only displays optimized, lightweight SVG files without heavy external scripts or bulky base64 data.

🎯 Key Features

  • Excalidraw Editor – intuitive drawing tools.
  • Lightweight SVG – optimized output for SEO.
  • Media Library Integration – seamless image management.
  • User-Friendly Interface – create diagrams in seconds with zero learning curve.
  • Custom Styling – choose colors, fonts, and line styles to match your brand.
  • Responsive Design – diagrams look sharp on desktops, tablets, and mobile.
  • Save & Reuse – store templates and reuse diagrams across your site.
  • GDPR-Compliant – no data tracking or external servers, your work stays private.
  • Shortcode & Block Support – embed diagrams anywhere using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes.

NinjaDraw Free – General Features
⚡ Number of diagrams: Max 5
✅ Vector Elements: rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, text
✅ Image: insert images from Media Library, just URL
✅ Smart Undo/Redo History: full history stack to undo/redo changes.

NinjaDraw Pro includes everything from Free, plus:
✅✨ Unlimited Diagrams for enterprise-scale projects.
✅✨ Open file – open and edit native .excalidraw files directly.
✅✨ Frame tool – group and organize elements into clean layout frames.
✅✨ Web embeds – easily embed external interactive web content into diagrams.
✅✨ Laser pointer – highlight elements in real-time during live presentations.
✅✨ Mermaid import – instantly convert text scripts into diagrams.

✨ Effortless Diagram Creation

Harness the power of Excalidraw’s intuitive tools directly in your WordPress editor. Create professional mind maps, process charts, and wireframes with drag-and-drop simplicity.

✨ Why Choose NinjaDraw?

  • Seamless Integration: Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, and all major themes.
  • Export Options: Save diagrams as PNG/SVG for sharing or offline use.
  • Privacy First: GDPR-compliant – no data collection without consent.

🚀 COMPATIBILITY

Not all themes and plugins are built the same way, so NinjaDraw is designed with extra compatibility in mind.​ NinjaDraw works seamlessly with modern WordPress themes and popular page builders that support standard blocks and shortcodes.

PAGE BUILDERS
* Gutenberg – modern built-in WordPress block editor
* Classic Editor – classic built-in WordPress editor
* Elementor – leading website builder platform on WordPress
* WP Bakery – create any layout with intuitive way
* Beaver – page builder you can trust with your business
* Bricks – amazing block editor with many templates
* Brizy – next-gen website builder that anyone can use
* and more…

💼 GDPR & Privacy

  • We do not collect or store any information about our visitors or users without their consent.
  • We also do not transfer any data to external servers without users’ consent.

🔥 Check out our other WordPress Plugins

HappyVR – virtual tour builder and 360 panorama viewer for WordPress
MediaCommander – bring folders to media, posts, and pages
Post Order Master – free drag & drop hierarchy manager
PicPoints – create interactive images and multi-level floor plans in minutes

Support

Found an issue or have a feature request? Head over to our support forum or drop us an email for assistance. We’re here to help you create stunning mindflow diagrams with ease!
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “NinjaDraw”.
  3. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  4. Use the Gutenberg block or shortcode [ninjadraw id="123"] to embed diagrams!
sections.faq:
Can I use NinjaDraw with Elementor?

Yes! NinjaDraw works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and all major page builders.

Are diagrams responsive?

Absolutely! Your diagrams adapt flawlessly to all screen sizes.

Where is the developer version hosted?

The developer version is available here.

Is NinjaDraw GDPR compliant?

Yes! We don’t collect or store user data without consent.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added: Insert images from WordPress Media Library directly into diagrams via the image tool
  • Changed: Migrated editor to ESM with lazy loading for faster page load
  • Fixed: Fixed unstyled content flash on editor page

1.2.2

  • Changed: Compatibility with WP 7.0

1.2.1

  • Changed: Upgrade admin notice on the plugin pages (dismissible for 30 days)
  • Fixed: Compatibility with PHP 7.4

1.2.0

  • Fixed: Switched from ES module to UMD build to prevent global variable duplication errors in WordPress environment
  • Changed: Compatibility with WP 6.9

1.1.0

  • Added: Brand new redesigned version

1.0.0

Initial release
